milestone: Launched a new Shopify store and moved directly into iterative optimization
problem: Product, checkout, payment and shipping processes had to become production-ready at the same time.
solution: Used a staged launch followed by end-to-end test orders, process corrections and continuous QA.
insight: A launch is not the finish line; it is the start of operational optimization.

milestone: Defined a centralized GTM tracking architecture
problem: Shopify, GA4 and Google Ads could create overlapping tags and duplicate measurement.
solution: Defined Google Tag Manager as the central control layer and reduced parallel measurement paths.
insight: Reliable performance decisions require conversion governance before optimization.

milestone: Built a structured Google Search campaign architecture
problem: Search match types and campaign intent were initially too broad to evaluate cleanly.
solution: Separated keyword logic by match type and later moved toward tighter, intent-led Search campaigns.
insight: For a small budget, control and search-intent clarity can matter more than automated scale.

milestone: Created a consistent product-image system
problem: Products, colors and mounting details were difficult to compare because imagery was inconsistent.
solution: Defined a repeatable image standard for spacing, background, shadow and product accuracy.
insight: Consistent product imagery improves recognition and variant comprehension without sacrificing technical accuracy.

milestone: Moved shipping clarity into the cart
problem: Customers could not confidently estimate delivery costs before reaching checkout.
solution: Added a concise shipping explanation directly in the cart and aligned it with the actual shipping rules.
insight: Shipping transparency removes uncertainty at a high-friction point in the buying journey.

milestone: Validated the complete order lifecycle with real test orders
problem: Backend configuration alone could not reveal every customer-facing failure.
solution: Ran B2C and B2B test purchases across desktop, mobile and payment methods, including invoice, cancellation and credit-note flows.
insight: E-commerce QA has to cover the full order lifecycle, not only the storefront.

milestone: Removed duplicate purchase measurement
problem: Shopify apps, pixels, GA4 and Ads could all send purchase events in parallel.
solution: Reduced direct measurement paths and centralized event control through GTM.
insight: ROAS and conversion analysis are only useful when the underlying event model is trustworthy.

milestone: Paused PMax after high traffic failed to produce purchases
problem: Roughly 50k impressions and 1.3k clicks produced no verified purchases while spend continued.
solution: Stopped the campaign, reassessed traffic quality and shifted toward more controlled Search testing.
insight: Impressions and clicks are not success metrics when the business outcome is missing.

milestone: Used external before/after testing to validate the redesign
problem: Internal familiarity with the shop could hide usability and perception issues.
solution: Compared old and new designs with external users and asked about clarity, trust and purchase confidence.
insight: Qualitative testing reveals both positive patterns and useful dissent that internal teams may miss.

milestone: Ran an end-to-end usability test from homepage to checkout
problem: Internal shop knowledge could mask navigation and decision friction.
solution: Let an external user navigate independently through categories, product pages, guidance content and checkout.
insight: A complete external journey test is a stronger validation than isolated component checks.

milestone: Added Microsoft Clarity to the analytics stack
problem: GA4 could show where users dropped off, but not why they hesitated.
solution: Added heatmaps and session recordings to complement quantitative funnel analysis.
insight: Behavior data is strongest when quantitative and qualitative evidence are used together.

milestone: Expanded the mini-cart with order review and two-step CTA logic
problem: Customers needed a clearer moment to review their order before continuing to checkout.
solution: Added an order-check step and clearer next actions inside the mini-cart.
insight: Small changes close to checkout can improve confidence without adding unnecessary complexity.

milestone: Moved trust information closer to the decision point
problem: Important trust signals were available but not prominent enough when customers first evaluated products.
solution: Integrated a Händlerbund trust element above the fold and strengthened shipping/payment communication.
insight: Trust works best where uncertainty happens, not only in the footer.

milestone: Designed a project-based fence configurator around real planning questions
problem: Buying a fence requires more than choosing a product: customers have to solve lengths, corners, mounting, cutting and accessories.
solution: Structured configuration around the customer's physical project rather than around a traditional product variant form.
insight: Complex products become easier to buy when the interface mirrors the customer's real-world task.

milestone: Built calculation logic for panel grids, cuts and direction changes
problem: Real properties do not fit perfectly into standard fence-panel dimensions or 90-degree layouts.
solution: Developed rules for panel counts, cutting, corners and direction changes so the material plan could adapt to the project.
insight: A useful configurator has to model real-world exceptions, not only ideal cases.

milestone: Implemented the configurator as a technically decoupled Shopify landing page
problem: The configurator needed freedom from standard product-template limitations while still using Shopify products and cart logic.
solution: Built a dedicated landing-page implementation connected to Shopify product data and cart behavior.
insight: Decoupling the experience layer can create more UX freedom without abandoning the commerce backend.

milestone: Put Price Check and Fence Configurator on the same Shopify product logic
problem: Two planning tools could create inconsistent prices, variants or material assumptions if they evolved separately.
solution: Connected both tools to the same product and pricing logic.
insight: Connected customer tools need a shared source of truth to stay trustworthy.

milestone: Built rule-based material and mounting calculations
problem: Customers needed to know not only how much fence they wanted, but which posts, fixings and mounting options were required.
solution: Translated project choices into a material list with context-dependent mounting components.
insight: Decision support reduces uncertainty when it converts project intent into an actionable bill of materials.

milestone: Created a seamless handoff from Price Check to full configuration
problem: A price-oriented visitor should not have to start over when they become ready to plan the whole project.
solution: Designed the Price Check as an entry point that can lead directly into the full fence configuration flow.
insight: Good journeys preserve momentum as user intent becomes stronger.

milestone: Prevented duplicate cart positions between Price Check and Configurator
problem: A customer could first add products from the Price Check and later generate a complete fence, accidentally creating duplicate quantities.
solution: Added conflict logic that asks whether existing matching items should be replaced or kept.
insight: The system should remember earlier customer actions and protect them from avoidable ordering errors.

milestone: Added a privacy-screen configurator to the fence-planning journey
problem: Privacy requirements are part of the same project but can require different material and design decisions.
solution: Built a dedicated privacy-screen flow with color and pattern options and integrated it with fence planning.
insight: Extending an existing project context creates more value than forcing customers into disconnected product journeys.

milestone: Restructured the homepage to surface planning tools earlier
problem: Price Check, Fence Configurator and complete sets could only help if visitors discovered them before browsing isolated products.
solution: Added a prominent planning section with clear entry paths before individual products.
insight: New commerce functionality needs deliberate placement inside the information architecture.

milestone: Launched a Search campaign specifically for the planning tools
problem: Customers with clear planning intent needed a direct route to Price Check and configurators from Google.
solution: Created separate ad groups for fence planning, Price Check and privacy-screen configuration.
insight: Digital advisory tools can become their own search intents and should be measured separately.

milestone: Connected installation content back into the buying journey
problem: An installation video could educate users but still leave them without a clear next step.
solution: Adapted the DIY video for mobile viewing and ended it with the configurator as the next action.
insight: Content and commerce become stronger when educational content reconnects to the next customer decision.

milestone: Designed a user-centered information structure for an outdoor alarm system
problem: A technical solution needed to explain use cases, components and installation without overwhelming users.
solution: Structured the page around customer questions and decision points, with technical detail available as deeper guidance.
insight: Technical products need progressive disclosure: clarity first, depth when the user asks for it.

milestone: Separated educational network-cable content from the commercial category
problem: A long guide inside the shop category pushed products down and blurred purchase intent.
solution: Created a dedicated educational guide and kept the category focused on commerce, connecting both through internal links.
insight: Editorial and commercial pages should serve different search intents while supporting each other.

milestone: Built a conversion path from informational landing page to shop
problem: Users could consume technical information without a clear next step toward a relevant product solution.
solution: Added clear shop CTAs and internal links that moved from the security problem to the appropriate commerce destination.
insight: Every advisory page needs an intentional next step in the customer journey.

milestone: Built an alarm-system category around both SEO and buying guidance
problem: The Magento category needed to complement TYPO3 content without creating duplicate content.
solution: Created independent commerce content for the category and linked it to the deeper advisory landing page.
insight: A content hub and a shop category can target different intents inside one connected architecture.

milestone: Analyzed duplicate-content and canonical issues across product paths
problem: The same products were reachable through multiple URLs, fragmenting ranking signals.
solution: Defined a primary SEO target and clearer canonical hierarchy.
insight: Multi-path catalogs need an explicit URL hierarchy to preserve search signals.

milestone: Diagnosed a sudden increase in 404 errors and redirect loops
problem: Broken and circular redirects created crawl waste and unstable user paths.
solution: Traced the redirect chain, cleaned loops and regenerated Magento URL rewrites/category paths where required.
insight: Technical SEO fixes need both root-cause analysis and validation after regeneration.

milestone: Created a reusable manufacturer-content framework
problem: Manufacturer pages needed consistency without duplicating the same content structure word for word.
solution: Standardized page logic, above-the-fold content, jump navigation and FAQs while keeping manufacturer-specific content unique.
insight: Reusable frameworks scale quality when structure is standardized but content remains specific.

milestone: Built a reusable content box inside Magento constraints
problem: The CMS reacted unpredictably to some CSS patterns and made flexible layouts difficult.
solution: Implemented a compatible HTML/CSS structure that stayed stable within the existing CMS limitations.
insight: In restrictive CMS environments, robust simplicity beats unnecessary styling complexity.

milestone: Designed an SEO and UX relaunch roadmap for an underperforming category
problem: The category had weak visibility, outdated content and unclear purchase guidance.
solution: Reworked URL, metadata, keyword clusters, manufacturer comparison and the decision journey as one connected roadmap.
insight: Weak category performance often requires structural change rather than another isolated content edit.

milestone: Aligned a WAGO category with the language customers actually search for
problem: Internal product terminology did not fully match real search language.
solution: Built a keyword strategy and terminology table around the terms users actually use.
insight: Search strategy improves when product taxonomy is translated into customer language.

milestone: Converted 36 ABB circuit-breaker products into a scalable variant model
problem: Individual child products needed a valid combination logic across amperage, pole count and characteristic.
solution: Created an attribute matrix and validated the shop inventory against a single source of truth.
insight: Clean product data and a strong attribute model are prerequisites for scalable configurable products.

milestone: Solved a Magento widget-rendering issue with a stable production workaround
problem: New widget instances rendered in test but not in production despite correct theme, block, container and cache settings.
solution: Validated the CMS block directly, then reused a proven global sidebar block and integrated the new content inside it.
insight: When a platform layer is unreliable, a tested stable structure can be the safer production path.
